tags.flaky-test: A test or check failed and then passed with no change.
tags.gate-wait: Waiting on Tollgate's gate stage or its queue longer than the gate's budget.
tags.release-red: A red release run, one's own or inherited, cost time.
tags.tool-failure: Tollgate, Hive, Beads, cargo, uv or a check script failed in a way that was not the bead's own bug (file a tooling bead too).
tags.tollgate-config-main-checkout: Tollgate reads .tollgate/config.toml only from the main checkout, so a policy change can't be validated or applied from the worktree.
tags.slow-check: A focused or fast check took long enough to slow iteration.
tags.slow-build: A cargo or npm build took long enough to slow iteration.
tags.oracle-diff-unreadable: An oracle or parity mismatch was hard to locate from its output.
tags.plan-unclear: The plan or bead left a choice open, or contradicted the code, and it took time to settle.
tags.prerequisite-wait: Waiting on another bead, a peer or a missing input.
tags.usage-limit-wait: Waiting on a model usage limit.
tags.capture-permission-pending: A System-mode check waited on the user's capture permission.
tags.merge-conflict: A Tollgate collision or rebase onto a peer's change.
tags.review-churn: Review findings that took long to verify or fix.
tags.host-load-noise: Measurements disturbed by other work on the shared machine.
